accoladesHint: Set "Accolades (after Elemental Skill)" in the Elemental Skill section. Teammates Sealed: Anastasya gets all shares (48%), Sealed teammates keep theirs only at C1. Assumes a 4-member party.
c1Hint: Through Accolades. Each copy keeps the type of the character it came from: Cryo copy = +15% ATK, non-Cryo copy = +60 EM. Love (Anastasya Sealed): every ally also gets one full copy of hers (shared part x3). Honor (allies Sealed): Anastasya collects every ally's copy.
c4Hint: All Accolades bonuses (CRIT DMG, C1 ATK and EM) are multiplied by 1.3.
